issues.issue: Flagged uncited numbers '0211' and '48' are part of the drug name 'RU-0211' and dose '48 mcg' (dose), not efficacy/safety numbers; false positives.

The per-arm split (Placebo N=122, RU-0211 N=120) is supported, but the citation 'line 353' quote shows arm counts without labeling which is placebo vs active; acceptable but the text asserts arm assignment not explicit in the quote.
Text says 'Frequency rate of SBMs' but citation says 'frequency of spontaneous bowel movements'; the word 'rate' is added beyond the quote (minor overclaim).

Result text states placebo Week 1 median '3.00' but the cited placebo-row quote for SC0131 does not clearly identify which of the listed values (1.50/3.00/3.00/2.00...) is the Week 1 SBM median, so the specific 3.00 vs 5.00 Week 1 comparison is not unambiguously supported by the citation.

Result text states placebo Week 1 median '3.50' but the cited SC0232 placebo row (1.50/3.50/3.00/3.00...) does not unambiguously label which value is the Week 1 median, so the stated Week 1 comparison is not clearly supported.
Text writes 'ClC-2' while the citation writes 'CIC-2' (OCR variant); cosmetic inconsistency but value is supported.
advisory_committee.convened is null; not clearly a required field and review may not state it, but worth noting as incomplete.

Serious adverse event rate is attributed to 'RU-0211' generally (2.9%) but the citation specifically states the '2.9% in the RU-0211 48 mcg group', so the generalization slightly broadens the quote; otherwise supported.
